critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/job_search.py::email_document_kit (lines 413-460) correctly gates with require_auth (401), returns 404 when doc/content missing, base64-encodes PDFs, passes template_key='job_search_kit_email' so the scoped exemption applies, and returns Response {success, sent_to, attachments}. Filename convention (cv-{job_id}.pdf / cover-letter-{job_id}.pdf) aligns exactly with _is_job_search_kit_attachment_exempt substring check. Non-blocker: if the email provider returns success but the dedupe layer suppresses, the response still says success:true — matches review-request note.

/app/backend/utils/email_service.py::_is_job_search_kit_attachment_exempt (lines 1268-1274) is tightly scoped: (a) exact template_key match against a single-item set, (b) filename prefix 'cv-' OR 'cover-letter-' AND suffix '.pdf'. No wildcard leakage — verified in the four unit assertions above.

/app/backend/utils/email_service.py::_apply_pdf_theme_policy_to_attachments (lines 1277-1360) checks learning-cert exemption first, then job-search-kit exemption, then falls through to enforce_pdf_v15_theme_bytes. Order is correct and mutually exclusive — a rogue 'cv-x.pdf' under a receipt template still gets v15 enforcement, preserving the standing UNBRANDED-for-job-search-only mandate without weakening the platform-wide theme policy.

/app/frontend/src/components/jobSearch/DocumentsTab.tsx emailKit handler is straightforward: POST to /documents/{job_id}/email with credentials, on success sets status i18n key jobSearch.docs.emailKitSent with sent_to interpolation. Button has data-testid='job-search-email-kit-btn' and status has data-testid='job-search-docs-status' — both selectors resolved cleanly in Playwright.
